canvas-bone.$description: Canvas Bone — Page background, section bands, large surface fills — the warm off-white that defines the entire atmosphere

card-white.$description: Card White — Card surfaces, elevated panels, input backgrounds, footer — pure white sitting on the bone canvas

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, filled action buttons, icon strokes, nav color — the dominant near-black that carries all type and the filled dark CTA

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, button text, nav strokes — slightly softer than Ink Black for de-emphasized copy

hairline.$description: Hairline — Default 1px borders on cards, inputs, dividers — the thinnest structural line

soft-border.$description: Soft Border — Secondary borders, subtle surface backgrounds — softer than Hairline for nested edges

muted-ink.$description: Muted Ink — Tertiary text, disabled states, muted icon strokes

lime-wash.$description: Lime Wash — Primary CTA fill (Start Building button) — a pale lime that glows against the bone canvas like a fresh highlighter mark

lime-edge.$description: Lime Edge — Green accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Logo color, decorative fill accents, secondary action — vivid orange used sparingly to anchor brand identity

sunset-gradient.$description: Sunset Gradient — Full-bleed section banner — a warm peach-to-coral gradient used as a single atmospheric band between content sections

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Hero radial gradient — a cool blue-cyan that radiates from the top of the hero section, giving the page an airy open-sky feeling

wixmadefortext.$description: Primary UI sans — body text, buttons, nav, inputs, badges, all chrome. The geometric forms and slightly expanded tracking on small sizes (0.025em at 12px, 0.18em uppercase) give it a friendly, slightly humanist feel that keeps 16px body text comfortable to scan

wixmisoregular.$description: Display headline face — used at 48-56px with tight tracking (-0.02em) and very tight line-height (1.05). The single weight at 400 creates a calm, confident headline that doesn't shout — authority through spaciousness. Body sizes (20-24px) share the same character, keeping the type system coherent across scales

wixmisolight.$description: Secondary display — lighter weight version for subheadings (25px) and lead body text (17px), creating tonal contrast against the Regular headlines. Same family guarantees harmony while the weight difference adds hierarchy without size jumps
